title: EOMasters Newsletter #014
description: A hand-picked selection of news from the field of EO and RS
html:
EOMasters Newsletter #014

31/12/2023

In this Issue:

This newsletter is distinct from the others. The end of the year is approaching, and it is time to reflect and forecast what lies ahead. This is an excellent opportunity. In terms of news, the recent time has been relatively calm.

EOMasters now exists for six months. The news regarding EOMasters tutorials and blogs belong to the entries of the newsletter you were most interested in and clicked on the most. The number of newsletter subscribers has doubled since mid-October. Thank you kindly. 💚🧡💙

To provide those who joined the newsletter later an opportunity to study the tutorials and blogs, I've listed them here:

Tutorials:

  • EO Data Processing with SNAP and Excel!

    • EOM-EO_Data_Processing_with_Excel_and_SNAP-v1.pdf (dropbox.com)

  • EOMMini - The Importance of Flags

  • EOMMini - Resolutions in Earth Observation

  • EOMMini - Spatial Resolution of SAR Systems

Blogs:

  • Hello EO-Masters!

  • Satellite Boom - It is Getting Crowdy!

  • The Earth is in our Hands. Really?

  • Where to get EO Remote Sensing Data?

  • Thoughts of a Dev - Is it worth it?

Other news you were interested in are:

  • First example notebooks available in Jupyter Lab | Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem

  • ESA - ESA’s highlights in 2024

  • Copernicus Sentinel-2 Collection-1 - Few anomalous products to be ignored

Unfortunately, software could not be provided to you till now. The software in development requires the next SNAP release. According to the most recent information, it will be launched in January. Let us all cross our fingers!

However, soon following the introduction of SNAP 10, you will be able to use the EOMasters Toolbox and the EOMasters Davalien (Data Validation Environment). These two pieces of software are only the beginning.

As we are currently looking to the future. You can expect more tutorials next year. Especially with a focus on development with and for SNAP. There will also be more tutorials on how to use SNAP.

The blog will continue to be updated on an infrequent basis, and the newsletter will continue to appear in your inbox on a regular basis.

That’s it for this year. I hope you had a wonderful year 2023 and that the next year will be even better. I wish you happiness, health, and success in everything you do. 🍀

Newsletter Archive

For past editions of this newsletter, you can visit the archive.

That's it for this issue. I hope you enjoyed this collection of news. Stay tuned for the next edition, which will arrive in your inbox in about two weeks.

Tschüss and Goodbye!

Marco
